verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature pages say users can create custom automation rules, with Rovo AI assistance, that send reminders, move work forward and keep Jira up to date without manual effort. Together these describe background automation the product itself provides. The evidence is only marketing-level, though. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of triggers, recurring schedules and background execution, limits on autonomous runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
